issues.description: The problem statement contains a contradictory return type for getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): the textual task description (lines 43-45) specifies that the method should return a String in the format "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)", but the UML diagram lists the method as returning void (line 71). The solution implementation returns a String. This mismatch between UML and textual description (and the solution) can mislead students — especially because another hint in the statement refers students to the UML for expected return types — and may cause them to implement the wrong signature (void) and fail tests.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the problem statement consistent by updating the UML diagram to show getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String (matching the textual description and the solution). Also update or remove the hint that directs students to rely on the UML for expected return types, so it doesn't conflict with the textual specification.
